Proficient, modern prose and dialogue, enhanced by lifestyle details, make an ancient epic especially accessible. An enjoyable, inventive Trojan War tale with an intriguing final twist and a serious message." Kirkus Reviews "Tender, compelling, dazzling. History, myth, intrigue, and long-buried secrets mark this beautifully told story. Fritsch's extraordinary storytelling abilities shine as he brings to life the larger-than-life heroes and villains of the Trojan War. The skillfully evoked era and meticulously researched period details, combined with the crisp, straightforward prose and smoothly paced narrative make for a page-turning story pulsing with romance, sacrifice, conspiracies, betrayals, and battles. Lovers of Greek mythology and historical fiction won't want to miss this one." The Prairies Book Review "Fritsch crafts a detailed and immersive fiction that is charming in its minute detail. Helen's point-of-view passages give the legend charm and agency. Fritsch's new spin on a timeless tale will draw in readers with his sympathetic characterization and original inventions." BookLife Reviews "Fritsch did an amazing job creating this story. I really enjoyed reading it and did so in a single sitting. Fans of Greek mythology and ancient history will really enjoy this novel." Reader Views "Fritsch spins a complex web of secrets and revelations that keep the reader engaged throughout. His plot lines are constantly moving forward toward an inevitable collision. His ability to objectively examine alternative angles of a classical work is commendable." US Review of Books From the Author Helen's Orphans has won the gold medal in the LGBTQIA category of the 2020-2021 Reader Views Literary Awards. The novel has won a finalist award in the 2021 Book Excellence Awards. From the Back Cover Did Helen choose to run off to Troy with Paris, or did he force her to go with him? Two orphans of the Trojan War, the tragic conflict Helen's elopement or abduction precipitated, search for the answer to one of the oldest questions in history--and discover much more. About the Author Fritsch has written ten award-winning novels, mainly in the historical fiction and mystery genres. Read more

2. **"Boombox Serenade"**
   - Price: $6.33
   - Average Rating: 5.0
   - Number of Reviews: 2
   - Rating Number: 2
   - Features: Joey Nicoletti’s Boombox Serenade drew me in with its immensely likeable persona. This astute and wise collection, drawing upon the poet’s mundane experiences as much as his wild fantasies, made me furiously interested in getting to know him through his previous books and to anticipate where he goes next. Boombox Serenade is not a one-off effort, a random assortment of musings, but rather a recollection of one’s argumentatively lived life at midpoint, with all the anticipation attached to a consummate aesthete’s reconfiguration of the apparently quotidian into a magical ride upon joy and ecstasy. The likeability is a rare treat in our age of overindulgence of personal foibles, and it comes from Nicoletti’s ability to distance himself (but not ironically or fatuously) from his private ups and downs and notice the connections to history and culture, without giving in to any of the currently popular fatalisms. The likeability also stems from the poet’s ability to control the emotional tone and charge of a particular narrative stride, so that we understand that he is not being tossed and turned by random sensations but, as he notes in “Poem Where I Become a Fan of The A-Team,” “how much fun can be had / when a plan comes together.” Often he’ll screw the tone dangerously close to sentimentalism, very intentionally so, but save himself (and us the readers) through mature humor, as in “Noise Rock.” Placing himself in a wide field taking in both popular and high culture, we observe him trying to make sense of the impressions fed to him by the guardians, as he allows himself to be affected by these impulses and decides how to shape his authentic self in response: another key aspect of his likeability, because he lets us in on his moderating thought processes without fear of judgment. If social media, and often literary self-presentation, has become all about managing an image to satisfy one’s real and imagined sponsors, Nicoletti comes across in Boombox Serenade as having no predetermined image, but rather as a lovable “cannoli gangster, armed with plastic / forks, spoons, pens, pencils, and dry-erase markers.” I love that there is not a trace of didacticism or self-importance in this wide-ranging collection, though the risk is ever-present, and that Nicoletti realizes the incomplete, flexible, shape-shifting nature of his mental evolution: “I am a mouthpiece, still taking shape / I am a saucepan filled with boiling water,” as he says in “Encouragement.” —Anis Shivani, author of Logography: A Poetry Omnibus Joey Nicoletti is the author of four poetry chapbooks and three full-length poetry collections. His poems, nonfiction, reviews, and articles have appeared in numerous journals and anthologies, including Valparaiso Poetry Review, Ovunque Siamo, Paterson Literary Review, Delirious: A Poetic Celebration of Prince; Drawn to Marvel: Poems from the Comic Books; and Rabbit Ears: TV Poems. A graduate of the University of Iowa, New Mexico State University, and the Sarah Lawrence College MFA program, Nicoletti teaches creative writing at SUNY Buffalo State.

3. **"Tom Swift Lives! Rocket Ship (Tom Swift reimagined!)"**
   - Price: $6.07
   - Average Rating: 5.0
   - Number of Reviews: 1
   - Rating Number: 1
   - Features: Tom Swift's third invention adventure takes the brilliant young inventor into outer space in an advanced spacecraft of his own design! But a mysterious competitor and his network of spies threaten not only Tom's revolutionary Star Spear, but the mammoth experimental rocket designed by Tom's father. A reclusive billionaire and an eerie informant add to the perplexing mystery -- a tale of furious action from the moment a flying figure breaches Fearing security to Tom and Bud's final confrontation in space with a hail of deadly missiles! Tom Swift reimagined—for today!

dialogue.agent:
Here are some of the top reviews for "Max's Midnight Swirl":

1. **Review by a Parent**
   - Rating: 5.0
   - Title: My two year old loves this book!
   - Text: My son loves this book. The pictures are really beautifully done, there's a lot to look at and talk about. The story has animals to athletes in it and he likes to point out what each thing is. The story has just the right amount of silliness to keep him super engaged. He thinks the ending is so funny (spoiler alert!) when the alarm goes off. Great book!!

2. **Review by a Scholar**
   - Rating: 5.0
   - Title: Max's swirl to the top of children's books
   - Text: The writing of a prodigious Ph.D. dissertation is a piece of cake compared to the insight and innovation that are required to create an outstanding children's book. Max's Midnight Swirl is one such example, and it is destined to become a classic!The beauty is found in the compelling simplicity of the basic idea, the inviting writing, and the imaginative graphic design of the wonderful personalities in Max's dream. I recommend this Prince of Children's Books for the young and those who love and guide them.

   Gary H. Quehl, Ph.D.

3. **Review by a Retired Teacher**
   - Rating: 5.0
   - Title: Retired teacher and now volunteer!
   - Text: As a retired Kindergarten and 1st Grade Teacher, I would have enjoyed reading this book to my classes.  With it's colorful illustrations of all the different kinds of animals, the limited amount of print on each page and the rhyming sentences, it is perfect for early listeners and readers.  It's a book that will stimulate the imagination of children and inspire them to write their own stories.  For teachers, it's an excellent example to teach rhyming, character personalities of the animals, beginning, middle and end - and many more literacy examples.

   As a volunteer next school year, I will definitely be reading this to students!

These reviews highlight the engaging and imaginative qualities of "Max's Midnight Swirl," making it a great choice for young readers and educators alike.

Max's Midnight Swirl is one such example, and it is destined to become a classic!The beauty is found in the compelling simplicity of the basic idea, the inviting writing, and the imaginative graphic design of the wonderful personalities in Max's dream. I recommend this Prince of Children's Books for the young and those who love and guide them.

Gary H. Quehl, Ph.D.

top_reviews.title: Retired teacher and now volunteer!
top_reviews.text:
As a retired Kindergarten and 1st Grade Teacher, I would have enjoyed reading this book to my classes. With it's colorful illustrations of all the different kinds of animals, the limited amount of print on each page and the rhyming sentences, it is perfect for early listeners and readers. It's a book that will stimulate the imagination of children and inspire them to write their own stories. For teachers, it's an excellent example to teach rhyming, character personalities of the animals, beginning, middle and end - and many more literacy examples.

As a volunteer next school year, I will definitely be reading this to students!
